title: HERMES Phase-2 shared-stream-recovery shadow-adapter configuration (deployment-readiness view)
description: DESIGN-ONLY, INERT. Governed config MODEL for the Phase-2 shadow adapter. Mirrors utils/hermes_sss_config_v1.ShadowAdapterConfig (contract version '1'). Config CONTENT lives in governed hermes_config (DB) and is MOUNTED at runtime, never embedded in the image and never read from a file/env by the module. This schema exists to validate proposed example configs and to gate a FUTURE, separately-authorised config-install WO. Presence of a valid config does NOT deploy or activate anything; enablement is a later independent mutation. shadow_enabled MUST be Boolean; only literal true (with shadow_consumer_live false) can ever enable. Missing/malformed/unknown-version -> fail-closed (DISABLED). No secrets permitted.

config_version.description: Contract version. Unknown version -> fail-closed DISABLED. Only '1' recognised.

shadow_enabled.description: The ONLY enable gate. MUST be a JSON boolean. No string coercion ('true'/'1'/'yes' are invalid types -> DISABLED). Absent -> DISABLED. Only literal true, together with shadow_consumer_live=false, yields an enabled adapter.

shadow_consumer_live.description: Must remain false. A true value is a validation error -> DISABLED. consumer_live=true can NEVER activate the shadow path.

shadow_eval_cadence_sec.description: Hybrid cadence: periodic evaluation interval seconds (bounded; ~watchdog interval). Event hooks are additional and dedup-bounded.

heartbeat_soft_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL (uncalibrated). Soft staleness horizon for AdapterHealth.last_tick_at heartbeat interpretation.

heartbeat_hard_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL. Hard staleness horizon; MUST be >= heartbeat_soft_horizon_s (enforced by loader; documented here).

shared_progress_soft_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL. Soft horizon for shared-progress interpretation of the same last_tick_at surface.

shared_progress_hard_horizon_s.description: PROVISIONAL. Hard horizon; MUST be >= shared_progress_soft_horizon_s.

callback_dedup_window_sec.description: Event-hook debounce window (seconds) so bursty event hooks cannot exceed the cadence budget.

max_callback_shadow_events_per_min.description: Upper bound on shadow evaluations triggered by event hooks per minute (overload guard).

snapshot_retention_days.description: Retention horizon (days) for evidence snapshots. Retention is enforced by count of rotated files + operator policy; days documents intent.

max_jsonl_bytes.description: Bounded active JSONL size before rotation.

max_retained_files.description: Maximum rotated JSONL files retained; oldest pruned.

write_timeout_s.description: Bounded per-write budget; a write exceeding this is a bounded, isolated failure, never a block on the market-data/recovery path.

evidence_output_path.description: Container-internal evidence path for the JSONL sink. MOUNTED (project-owned volume), never embedded, never a host-global or /etc path. No secrets. Path is created lazily by the writer only when an enabled adapter first appends; at image start NOTHING is created.

alert_on_comparison_classes.description: Subset of the 10 ComparisonClass values that should raise an operator alert when observed.

horizons_provisional.description: MUST be true while horizons are uncalibrated. Records that thresholds are provisional, not calibrated truth.

disabled_reason.description: Optional. When the loader fails closed, the reason it disabled. Present only on a disabled config.
